artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.medium: graphite with crayon on purple laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image displays a seated person seen from the back. Their right arm is extended forward, and they are leaning slightly to their right. The person's head is turned to the side, hiding their face, with their hair styled in a bun. They are partially covered by a long garment that gathers around their lower body. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.medium: graphite with crayon on purple laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with one knee raised and arms resting on the knee. Their facial features are outlined with subtle shading, and they have styled hair. The individual is draped in loose clothing. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is a plain sheet of paper.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.medium: crayon on purple laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a dynamic walking pose. The figure has no facial features, wearing a cap or headwrap. They are dressed in flowing garments suggesting movement, with folds accentuating the direction of motion. The left arm is extended forward, the right hand slightly raised. There are no visible accessories. The background is a light purple shade contrasting with the earthy red tones of the figure.

artworks.title: Female Nude with Necklace
artworks.medium: graphite and chalk on purple laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with their body slightly turned to the side. Both hands are raised near the neck area. The person's face is detailed with eyes, a nose, and lips. Their hair is styled in an updo with curls around the face. The person is nude but wearing a necklace. The background is a plain, muted pink color.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.medium: graphite with white chalk on purple wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped fabric. The image showcases the fabric's folds, twists, and flow with a high degree of realism. The fabric looks soft and voluminous, with light and shadow illustrating its folds and creases. The drawing is on a delicate background, enhancing the texture of the drapery. Shading creates a three-dimensional effect, highlighting the fabric's form.

artworks.title: Girl Spearing Dolphin
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude person standing on a rock, holding a spear with both hands. The figure has a downward gaze and detailed facial features and hair. There is no clothing or jewelry shown in the drawing, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Girl Spearing Dolphin
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on two sheets of adhered wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a person in a dynamic pose. The person is standing on one leg with their right foot on an elevated surface, while their left leg is bent at the knee. Their body is slightly twisted, with the left arm extended forward holding a spear. The person has short, wavy hair and their face is turned towards the left, with the facial features shown in profile. They are not wearing any visible clothing or jewelry. The drawing is on a plain background, and the figure is depicted in fine detail with shading. The surface they are standing on has a drape-like texture below the foot. The overall background is plain, focusing on the figure.

artworks.title: Girl Spearing Dolphin
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a nude female figure in a dynamic pose. She is leaning forward with one knee bent and her foot resting on a rocky surface, while her other leg is extended downward. Her torso twists slightly as she appears to be looking downward. Her hair is styled short, curling softly around her face and gathered up. The figure's facial features are delicately rendered, highlighting a calm expression with downward-cast eyes. She holds a long, pointed object with both hands in a position suggesting poised movement. The background is simple, with no distinct details, focusing on the figure. The image has a classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Study for "The Fates Gathering in the Stars"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawn profile view of a person's body from the knee up. The person's torso and head are turned slightly away from the viewer, arms extended forward. The facial features are detailed, with a subtle expression, and long hair or cloth flowing backward. The person is not clothed, except for a wide-brimmed hat. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is plain, lacking detailed scenery or additional objects. Soft shading and lines contribute to a classic and artistic appearance, with a small section of text on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Study for "The Fates Gathering in the Stars"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a nude person in a three-quarter view from the side. The person's head is turned slightly downward and facing left. One leg is raised at the knee, and one arm is stretched out in front. The facial features are roughly outlined in profile, with simple hair tied back. The sketch is on a textured grey background.

artworks.title: Study for "The Fates Gathering in the Stars"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a draped figure. The artwork is a detailed study of the drapery covering the mid-section and one thigh of a human form. The medium appears to consist of pencil or charcoal combined with white chalk on grey toned paper. The artist has rendered the fabric's texture and flow, capturing the play of light and shadow. The background is minimal, emphasizing the drapery and the part of the human form it covers.

artworks.title: Study for "The Fates Gathering in the Stars"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed sketch of a human arm, extending from the shoulder to the fingers, positioned horizontally across the frame. The arm is shaded to highlight muscle structure, with a slightly bent elbow leading to a loosely closed hand. There is no visible face or hair in the sketch. The arm is unclothed, showing only the skin and natural contours. The background is a plain, neutral-toned surface that contrasts with the black and white chalk rendering of the arm. Below the arm, there is handwritten text that reads "Study for the Fates," the location "Chicago," and a signature likely belonging to the artist's last name, "Vedder."

artworks.title: Study for "The Fates Gathering in the Stars"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite with white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a study of arms and hands. The drawing consists of sketches of a forearm and hand, each holding strands or threads. The background is a plain beige tone. The drawing is executed in a slightly freehand style with lines and shading suggesting the form and texture of the limb. White and brown chalk or pencil are used to add dimension and depth to the drawings, highlighting the muscles and contours of the arm and hand. Each sketch captures a different angle or action.

artworks.title: Nile Journey, No. 20
artworks.medium: charcoal and crayon on blue-gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a desert landscape with a low angle viewpoint. The horizon is about a third from the top, dividing the sky from the arid ground. On the horizon are rocky formations with flat tops and gentle slopes. Several camels lie near the viewer with a few figures in traditional robes. The brushstrokes are soft and sketchy, giving a sense of immediacy. The colors include browns, grays, and soft reds for the land, and light blue for the sky.

artworks.title: Nile Journey, No. 22
artworks.medium: charcoal and crayon on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows jagged rocks protruding from a calm body of water. In the distance, there are sandy, rolling hills creating a horizon line near the top third of the image. The landscape is detailed with texture in the hills. The pencil strokes provide shading and lighting effects on the rocks and land. The color palette consists of earth tones with muted shades dominating, while hints of blue are visible in the sky and water.

artworks.title: Man in Top Hat, Smoking a Cigar
artworks.medium: graphite with scratched highlights on blue-gray prepared wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, wife of the artist, 1955)
artworks.description: The image displays a three-quarter length portrait of a person in profile view, with their arms crossed. The person has facial hair, wearing a high top hat that covers part of the forehead. They are dressed in a dark suit jacket and have a cigar in their mouth. The background is a textured gray surface.

artworks.title: The Cadet
artworks.medium: graphite with scratched highlights on blue-gray prepared wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, wife of the artist, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, facing forward. He has a neutral expression, with his head slightly tilted to the right. His hands are on his lap, legs together. The man is wearing a brimmed cap, coat, trousers, and boots. The background is a grey surface, with light shadowing around the figure.

artworks.title: Standing Man
artworks.medium: graphite with scratched highlights on gray prepared wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, wife of the artist, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a relaxed pose. He has one hand on his hip and the other holding a small hat at his side. The man has a mustache and short, neatly-combed hair. He is dressed in a formal outfit with a buttoned jacket, collared shirt, tie, and trousers. The drawing is in shades of gray on a plain background, focusing solely on the man.

artworks.title: Study for "Portrait of Esther Haydin"
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, wife of the artist, 1955)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a young child's head and shoulders. The child is facing the viewer with a direct gaze. The sketch captures the child's facial features, including rounded cheeks, a small nose, slightly parted lips, and straight hair falling to shoulder length with bangs. The child appears to be wearing some type of garment, indicated by faint outlines around the shoulders. The background is minimal, focusing primarily on the child. No jewelry or objects are included in the sketch.

artworks.title: Watching the Bees
artworks.medium: pastel and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)
artworks.description: The image displays an adult and a child next to an upright rectangular structure. The adult, a woman, is partially turned towards the child while the child faces the structure. The woman has light-colored hair covered by a blue shawl and is wearing a long light-colored dress. The child has short blond hair and is dressed in a white shirt with dark shorts. The background features green vegetation and hints of trees. The painting is created with a soft pastel art style, with gentle strokes conveying a dappled sunlight effect.

artworks.title: When Other Friends Are Round Thee
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink, wash, and scratchwork on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rudolph Max Kauffmann, 1947)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a room. One person is seated on a step, facing the other person who is seated in a chair by a doorway. The man holds a stringed instrument and a dog sits beside him. The woman is looking down at a piece of paper she holds. The room has an ornate doorway with plants or vines along the sides.

artworks.title: Study for "War and Peace"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with wash on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1950)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a full-body sketch, upright and slightly turned to the left. The person is facing sideways with their head slightly up. Their hair is styled in an updo, and they wear a long robe with voluminous sleeves and a possible cloak. The person is holding a branch in their left hand. Next to them is a large block or pedestal. The background is plain with light shading framing the figure.

artworks.title: Group of Figures
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1950)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in a sketchy and textured style. Their bodies are primarily depicted in full, with most appearing seated or kneeling and facing a central figure. The central person is larger and standing upright, slightly bent forward. All individuals have obscured facial features and indistinguishable hair. Clothing is roughly drawn with shadowy strokes, suggesting heavy garments. Surrounding the figures are more lightly sketched forms, hinting at a cluster of people. The setting is lacking specific details, with a dark and hazy background, creating a mysterious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Vue ... et elévation des ... omnibus du boulevard ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an omnibus. The drawing depicts a horse-drawn omnibus with exaggerated features. It appears to be overfilled with passengers, some wearing top hats. The body of the omnibus is detailed, and the passengers are drawn with exaggerated expressions and proportions. Figures on the roof seem precariously balanced, with one figure attempting to climb aboard from the side. The style is typical of 19th-century satirical cartooning.
